Hi Tom / Alice —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good conversation and appreciate you walking through MedCore's constraints around PHI and auditability. As promised, attaching an initial MAP (redwood_map_v1.xlsx) focused on the Data Handling & Compliance milestone. High-level recap and suggested next steps below.

Summary (post-call)
- Primary ask: ensure Redwood can meet MedCore requirements for PHI handling, configurable retention, and detailed audit logs for inference events.
- Risk drivers: retention of KV cache, long-term logging of prompts/outputs, and whether any raw PHI leaves your VPC (for private deployments).

Proposed MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance — draft
- Description: Define and validate controls for retention, logging/audit trails, PHI/PII handling, and contractual commitments (DPA/BAA).
- Owner (Redwood): Marissa Cole (sales) + Rishi Malhotra (SE) + Neha Kapoor (Legal)
- Owner (MedCore): Tom Reynolds (CISO) + Alice Chen (Product Security)
- Deliverables:
  1) Technical note: retention options (per-request TTLs, KV cache purge, encryption-at-rest) — owner: Rishi — due 2026-07-10
  2) Compliance packet: SOC2 summary, logging schema, and audit sample — owner: Marissa — due 2026-07-12 (SOC2-Summary.pdf attached)
  3) Contract revisions: DPA/BAA language for PHI — owner: Neha — draft by 2026-07-14
  4) Joint validation: demo of logging & purge workflow in staging — target run week of 2026-07-20 (dependency: staging access & MDR dataset)
- Target close date: 2026-08-15 (sign DPA/BAA, confirm config for production)
- Dependencies: MedCore to confirm retention policy and sign-off authority; access to a staging environment with representative data; review of MedCore security questionnaire (thanks for sending during the call).

Open items / asks for MedCore
- Please confirm the maximum retention period you need for inference logs (e.g., 30/90/365 days) and whether de-identified logs are acceptable for audit trails.
- Who will be the authorized signatory for the DPA/BAA?
- Can you provide a staging account or sample telemetry to run the purge demo?

I dropped the initial MAP spreadsheet in the thread and linked the HubSpot deal (HC-4589). Let us know if you'd prefer changes to the milestones or owners. Happy to jump on a 30m follow-up next week to lock timelines.

Subject: Re: MAP draft: Data handling & compliance (PHI/PII, retention, logging)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Logging / audit trails: we need per-request audit entries that include a hashed user id, request timestamp, model version, and a trace id that we can map back to our systems. We cannot store raw PHI in logs for more than 30 days; de-identified logs for 365 days are acceptable for historical analysis.

2) De-identification at inference: Does Redwood offer an on-the-fly de-identification step (token-level redaction) before logs are persisted, or would that be a separate pre-processing step on our side?

3) For the purge demo: we can provide a staging workspace and a small synthetic dataset (with PHI placeholders).

Attaching our completed security questionnaire (MedCore_Security_Questionnaire.pdf) — it's short but will help.

If possible can we move the joint validation earlier to week of 2026-07-13? Our compliance window is tight.

Best,
Tom

CISO, MedCore Health

Tom/Marissa —

Quick legal note following Marissa's assignments. Short answers and next steps:

1) BAA/DPA: For PHI we will require a BAA in addition to our standard DPA. I will prepare a BAA draft and an accompanying redline to our standard DPA. Expect first draft to Marissa by 2026-07-12.

2) Contract signatory: please confirm who at MedCore is authorized to sign a BAA (title and contact). We'll need that for procurement timelines.

3) Audit and logging obligations: contract language will reflect (a) 30-day max retention for raw PHI logs, (b) ability for MedCore to request export of audit logs in machine-readable format, and (c) right to audit upon reasonable notice. If MedCore requires continuous third-party audits beyond our SOC2 schedule, we'll outline that as an optional add-on.

4) Data residency: if you require data to stay in a specific region, we can scope a Private deployment or Dedicated capacity with region pinning; we'll list that as a dependency in the MAP.

I'll circulate the first redline and mark sections that may need negotiation.

Thanks,
